strings.zh: 东城洞穴是连接城都{NEWLINE}和关东的交通要道,{CLEAR}所以精灵联盟在这里设置了哨岗,{CLEAR}以确保这条道路安全畅通。
strings.en: Tohjo Falls is a major route linking{NEWLINE}Johto and Kanto, so the Pokémon League{CLEAR}set up a guard post here to keep this{CLEAR}road safe and open.

strings.zh: 你好,请问你是要去城都地区吗？
strings.en: Hello, are you headed to the Johto{NEWLINE}region?

strings.zh: 不是啊……那真是太遗憾了。

太好了。{SCROLL}其实我被派到这儿来执勤快一年了,{NEWLINE}与我的……{CLEAR}与我的好朋友小桃分别这么久,{CLEAR}我非常想念她。{SCROLL}哨所这里还没有扯电话线,{NEWLINE}要联系到小桃有些困难,{CLEAR}于是我就给她写了一封信。{CLEAR}既然你要去城都地区旅行,{CLEAR}能请你帮我把这封信{CLEAR}带到缘朱市给小桃吗？拜托了。{SCROLL}是否帮警卫带信？
strings.en: Wonderful.{SCROLL}Actually, I’ve been on duty here for{NEWLINE}almost a year now, and I’ve been apart{CLEAR}from my... from my good friend Momo all{CLEAR}this time.{SCROLL}I miss her so much.{SCROLL}There’s no phone line out to this post{NEWLINE}yet, so it’s hard to reach Momo.{SCROLL}So I wrote her a letter.{SCROLL}Since you’re traveling to Johto, could{NEWLINE}you please take this letter to Momo in{CLEAR}Ecruteak City?{SCROLL}I’m counting on you.{SCROLL}Deliver the letter for the guard?
strings.notes: Names 小桃 → Momo and 佑一 (the guard) → Yuichi are romanised placeholders (no official source).

strings.zh: 谢谢你！{SCROLL}这是信,请你务必拿好。
strings.en: Thank you!{SCROLL}Here’s the letter. Please take good{NEWLINE}care of it.

strings.zh: 小桃在缘朱市很有名的,{NEWLINE}你应该很轻松就能找到她。{CLEAR}拜托了。
strings.en: Momo’s quite well known in Ecruteak{NEWLINE}City.{SCROLL}You should find her easily. I’m counting{NEWLINE}on you.

strings.zh: 小桃『幸好有冠军大人带来书信,{NEWLINE}小女子才能与佑一互吐心声,{CLEAR}了却心头一件大事。
strings.en: Momo: Thanks to the letter you{NEWLINE}brought, Champion, Yuichi and I could{CLEAR}finally open our hearts to each other.{SCROLL}It has taken a great weight off this{NEWLINE}humble girl’s mind.

strings.zh: 原来您是冠军大人啊,{NEWLINE}麻烦您给我带信真是不好意思。{CLEAR}但也多亏了您帮忙,{CLEAR}我才能和小桃正式确立关系,{CLEAR}这个是我的一点谢礼,{CLEAR}请您收下吧！
strings.en: Oh, you’re the Champion! I’m so sorry{NEWLINE}for troubling you to carry my letter.{SCROLL}But thanks to your help, Momo and I are{NEWLINE}officially a couple now.{SCROLL}This is a small token of my thanks.{NEWLINE}Please accept it!

strings.zh: 多谢冠军大人{NEWLINE}将我的信带到了小桃那里,{CLEAR}不然以我这害羞的个性,{CLEAR}说不定会留下一生的遗憾。
strings.en: Thank you so much for taking my letter{NEWLINE}to Momo, Champion.{SCROLL}As shy as I am, I might have lived with{NEWLINE}that regret for the rest of my life.

strings.zh: 曾经有一位我日夜思念{NEWLINE}深深爱着的女孩,{CLEAR}但因为缺少勇气,{CLEAR}我最终还是没能向她告白……{SCROLL}唉,算了,都是过去的事了,{NEWLINE}人生会有遗憾也是难免的。
strings.en: There was once a girl I loved deeply and{NEWLINE}thought about day and night.{SCROLL}But I never had the courage, and in the{NEWLINE}end, I never told her how I felt...{SCROLL}Sigh, oh well. It’s all in the past.{NEWLINE}Everyone has a few regrets in life.
